import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem power_period_mod_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : 1 < a)  :
  ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → n ∣ k → ((a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ k = 1) := by
  intro k hk_pos hdvd
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst hn0
    simp at hdvd
    omega
  · have ha_pos : 0 < a := by omega
    have h_pow_ge_one : 1 ≤ a ^ n := by
      calc 1 = 1 ^ n := by simp
        _ ≤ a ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left ha_pos n
    have h_a_pow_n_eq_one : (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ n = 1 := by
      have h_cast_pow : (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ n = ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) := by
        rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
      have h_one : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) = 1 := by
        have h_self : ((a ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self _
        have h_sub : ((a ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) =
            ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) - 1 := by
          have h := @Nat.cast_sub (ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) _ _ _ h_pow_ge_one
          simpa using h
        have h_eq : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) - 1 = 0 := by
          rw [← h_sub]
          exact h_self
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
      rw [h_cast_pow, h_one]
    rcases hdvd with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [pow_mul, h_a_pow_n_eq_one, one_pow]
